text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: It happened while I was walking through the hot spring town with the landlady……

text_block_list.name: Man in a Hat
text_block_list.text:
Well well, if it isn't the landlady!
Is that young one beside ya your apprentice?

text_block_list.name: Takeshi Hoshina
text_block_list.text:
Ufufu, goodness no.
They're a Trainer studying rest and recuperation
here at our inn.

text_block_list.name: Takeshi Hoshina
text_block_list.text: Are you all... playing mahjong again?

text_block_list.name: Man in Red Shirt
text_block_list.text:
That's right, but I'm getting kind of tired
of always playing with the usual crowd.

text_block_list.name: Smiling Old Man
text_block_list.text:
Hey there, youngster. Know how to play mahjong?
Care to join us for a round if you've got time?
choice_data_list: I'm no expert, but I'd love to!

text_block_list.name: Man in Red Shirt
text_block_list.text: Ron! Riichi, Pinfu, Dora 1—that's 3,900 points! Well, a win's a win... buuut...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The old men's eyes gather upon us. ...A total defeat.
The final point difference from first place was like night and day.
choice_data_list: It didn't lead to any points at all...

text_block_list.name: Smiling Old Man
text_block_list.text:
A-Ah, geez... Sorry about that, I might've
gone a bit too far...
I figured out the hand you were trying to build, you see.

text_block_list.name: Man in a Hat
text_block_list.text:
Well, ya naturally wanna aim for the hand that scores big points!
That's why I saw right through it, but...
Guess it's a learnin' experience... Or maybe I was just bein' petty...

text_block_list.name: Takeshi Hoshina
text_block_list.text:
Well then, everyone.
I shall be your next partner.
So, there is no need to hold back—is there?

text_block_list.name: Man in a Hat
text_block_list.text:
T-The landlady is...?! ...A-Alright.
I'm definitely taking the win today!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—Quietly, the tiles swapped places.
Looking over the landlady's tiles... not bad at all!
In fact, it's a hand ready to fight!
choice_data_list: (Looks like I can complete a high-scoring hand!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: However... the proprietress discarded a tile completely contrary to our reading—the very tile needed to complete her winning hand.
choice_data_list: (Wait…… why? She could've aimed for a high score……!)

text_block_list.name: Man in Red Shirt
text_block_list.text: All right, Ron! Pinfu, Red Five... That's 2,000 points! Heh heh, we're off to a great start~!
choice_data_list: (Guh, the hand wasn't worth much, but she got me!)

text_block_list.name: Man in Red Shirt
text_block_list.text:
I heard the landlady was a total demon at mahjong, though?
Is this really okay~? Should I just push through and go all the way?

text_block_list.name: Takeshi Hoshina
text_block_list.text: ...Hohoho.

text_block_list.name: Takeshi Hoshina
text_block_list.text: ...I hope you can pull it off.

text_block_list.name: Takeshi Hoshina
text_block_list.text: Shall we proceed to East Round 2?
choice_data_list: (What on earth could the proprietress be thinking...?)
(What on earth is the proprietress thinking...?)

text_block_list.name: Man in a Hat
text_block_list.text:
...She forced me to win with a cheap hand...!
She realized I was sitting on a high-value tenpai...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The match progressed. Through East 2 and East 3, the landlady couldn't manage to win a hand.
choice_data_list: (Haven't scored any points yet. This is really it... my final chance...)

text_block_list.name: Man in a Hat
text_block_list.text:
Pong! I'll take that Two of Dots!
Now then, now then...!

text_block_list.name: Smiling Old Man
text_block_list.text:
You sure love calling tiles, don'tcha...?
Droppin' your hand's value like that is crazy work.
You gotta sit tight and hold your ground more~.

text_block_list.name: Man in a Hat
text_block_list.text:
Cheap trick or not... I'll do whatever it takes to win.
You gotta scramble greedily for every inch... Hup!

text_block_list.name: Takeshi Hoshina
text_block_list.text: Indeed. That too is part of the contest—

text_block_list.name: Takeshi Hoshina
text_block_list.text:
Well then, I suppose it is time for me to go as well.
In my own way...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
That was when I realized.
The way to win at mahjong... is simply
to finish with a higher total score than anyone else.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The proprietress hasn't scored any winning hands. But...
the gap between her and the others isn't that wide.
Rather than going on the offensive, she's devoted herself to defense—
choice_data_list: (So the strategy was to protect her own lead all along!)
(So her strategy really was to protect her own lead!)

text_block_list.name: Takeshi Hoshina
text_block_list.text:
Just like life itself.
It is simply impossible for everything to always go smoothly.

text_block_list.name: Takeshi Hoshina
text_block_list.text: Still, no matter what happens—as long as we're smiling in the end, that's all that matters.

text_block_list.name: Takeshi Hoshina
text_block_list.text: Tsumo. Pinfu, Pure Straight, Self-Draw, Dora 1... Mangan. 2,000 / 4,000 points.

text_block_list.name: Man in Red Shirt
text_block_list.text:
Ooh~ nice move!
Score-wise, though...

text_block_list.name: Man in Red Shirt
text_block_list.text:
...!?
Th-There's a turnaround?!
choice_data_list: The core points haven't been disrupted, so what you did is plenty...!

text_block_list.name: Takeshi Hoshina
text_block_list.text: Indeed, there is no need for anything extravagant.

text_block_list.name: Takeshi Hoshina
text_block_list.text:
What to accomplish in the end.
As long as we determine that and proceed steadily—

text_block_list.name: Man in a Hat
text_block_list.text: ........I-I lost again...

text_block_list.name: Takeshi Hoshina
text_block_list.text: ...Fufu.

text_block_list.name: Takeshi Hoshina
text_block_list.text:
Not bad, right?
Living that way…… you know?
